senses.gloss: m. (b. h.), pl. חוֹרִין [white garments,] freedom; בֶּן ח׳, בַּת ח׳ free, freed, opp. to slave.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 4:4">Gitt. IV, 4</cite> <he>ועושה … בן ח׳</he> and he must declare him free.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 4:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>חציו עבד וחציו בן ח׳</he> half a slave and half a freedman; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="B01316"><he>בְּנֵי ח׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:3">B. Kam. I, 3</cite> <he>עדים ב׳ ח׳ וכ׳</he> witnesses who are freemen and of the Jewish faith.
Esth. R. to I, 6 (expl. חוּר ib.) בגדים שב׳ ח׳ וכ׳ garments which freemen wear; a. fr.—(נכסים) בני ח׳ free (not mortgaged) property, opp. משועבדים.
B. Kam. 8ᵇ; a. fr. [Bibl. Hebr. חוֹרִים, חֹרִים noblemen
